register: Neutral formal-polite consumer-app register with capitalised “Anda” (683 uses, no kamu/kau/-mu anywhere); bare imperatives without -lah on buttons (Simpan, Bagikan, Tandai); keep it.

avoid: berita (for a single story / story label)
terms.note: Catalog: ~536 artikel, ~377 cerita, ~192 berita, ~10 kisah. cerita/kisah is a tale (fiction calque); berita is ‘news’. Severity medium in labels, buttons, menu items, titles, view/folder names, counts and short status lines; low in prose. berita may stay where the English says news (River of News, news reader). No reduplication after numbers or quantifiers (5 artikel, semua artikel).
feed is the standard Indonesian tech term and the catalog's majority (513). umpan (‘bait’) → medium in labels, low in prose; suapan (‘spoon-feeding’) → medium/high.
situs web for website.
Next Unread Story → Artikel Belum Dibaca Berikutnya.

terms.use: Tandai sudah dibaca / Tandai telah dibaca / Tandai sebagai telah dibaca
terms.note: sudah/telah and with or without sebagai are all fine; not flagged.

avoid: Baca Berita / Baca Cerita / Baca Artikel (imperative)
terms.note: Folder of stories already read. Imperative = high. Siri/Spotlight ‘Read %@’ opens a feed: Baca %@ is correct.
Saved (state) → Tersimpan / Disimpan both fine.
Hapus dari tersimpan is acceptable; flag only broken forms.
Delete share → Hapus bagikan is broken; use Hapus artikel yang dibagikan / Batalkan berbagi depending on context.
Brand name, Latin, no -s plural.
Intelligence Trainer → Pelatih Kecerdasan; intelligence training → pelatihan kecerdasan. intelijen → medium.
Story trainer → Pelatih Artikel; Site trainer → Pelatih Situs.
klasifikasi for classifiers → low.

Focus stories → Artikel Fokus; Focus only → Hanya Fokus / Fokus saja. ‘Fokus pada artikel’ (imperative-ish ‘focus on articles’) for the Focus Stories label → medium. Verb ‘focus or hide’ may be menyorot/memfokuskan in prose.

terms.use: Suka / Tidak suka; Hide (the level above Like, formerly Super Dislike) → Sembunyikan
terms.note: beats → ‘>’ or ‘mengalahkan’ (Like outranks Dislike).

Hide is the strongest training level, above Like and Dislike (it was called Super dislike): a story that matches it is always hidden, whatever else it matches. Use the same word as the Hide button in the training controls, and quote it in sentences like the other level names (Sembunyikan mengalahkan semuanya). The old Super dislike names are retired.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
terms.note: Plan names stay English as product names, matching the App Store / Play Store and the es/fr/pt-BR/tr decisions; the catalog is split ~30 Arsip Premium vs ~26 Premium Archive. Arsip Premium → low in prose, medium in short labels/buttons/titles; bare Arsip for the Archive plan → medium (confusable with the story archive). Lowercase descriptive premium (fitur premium, akun premium, pelanggan premium) left alone.
Both Tingkatkan and Upgrade are common in Indonesian apps; mixing not flagged.
Premium Trial → Uji Coba Premium.

terms.use: Preferensi (NewsBlur's Preferences screen, all platforms); Pengaturan (generic settings, all platforms)
terms.note: Catalog uses Preferensi for Preferences (21) and Pengaturan for settings (50). Android's own UI says Setelan, but Pengaturan is equally standard (Samsung One UI, many apps) and consistent here, so not flagged.
Subscribed (state) → Berlangganan / Sudah berlangganan.
English left in → low untranslated; Arus Berita acceptable, low.

avoid: Semua Artikel Situs (ambiguous: all of the site's articles)
Semua Artikel di Situs / dari situs ini (one site)
terms.note: Stories from all sites. Readings that clearly mean one site → high; the ambiguous Semua Artikel/Cerita/Berita Situs → low (medium when it also has the wrong story term).
Majority form; keep.
Good Reads is a folder of good stories.
Briefing alone → Ringkasan. English ‘Briefing’ left in labels → low/medium untranslated.
English in a short UI label → medium, in prose → low.

terms.use: Pertanyaan lanjutan… (input placeholder) / Pertanyaan lanjutan (Follow-ups section)
terms.note: Follow up to N sites → Ikuti hingga N situs (correct).
I'm Following → Saya Ikuti / Saya Mengikuti, Following Me → Mengikuti Saya; distinguishable.

avoid: Bunyikan / Suarakan / Aktifkan suara (sound) for unmute
terms.note: Muting a site hides it. Batal bisukan is the clearest antonym and is used consistently in the verified set. Note that Bunyikan/Suarakan are attested as the Bisukan antonym in Instagram and WhatsApp Indonesian, so the sound wording is a clarity/consistency problem for a hidden feed rather than text readers cannot parse; Aktifkan suara (turn on the sound) is the genuinely misleading form.
pemberitahuan also acceptable.
Newsletter (English) is also common in Indonesian; mixing not flagged.
Umpan Web → medium in labels; English Web Feeds left in → low.

terms.use: Tampilan Teks / Tampilan Artikel / Tampilan Feed / Tampilan Asli (Original)
%(time)s yang lalu / %@ yang lalu; bare units %(number)d hari/jam/menit/detik
terms.note: Indonesian has no case or plural change, wrappers work with bare units.
Comma thousands → low typography.

avoid: Lebih baru: / Lebih lama: as sort order
terms.note: Lebih baru dari / Lebih lama dari also fine.

terms.use: Pagi / Siang / Sore (Morning + Afternoon → Pagi + Siang, Morning + Evening → Pagi + Sore)
terms.note: apps/briefing/tasks.py SLOT_TIMES: morning 8:30, afternoon 12:30, evening 17:00. 12:30 is siang and 17:00 is sore; malam begins after dark, so an Evening briefing at 17:00 must not be Ringkasan Malam. Web and iOS already use Siang/Sore; the iOS Afternoon Briefing title and Android Evening were the outliers.
